value.signature: fn compare_proof < H : ClosureHeader > (input : Option < & [u8] > , anchor : Option < OpeningAnchor < '_ , H > > ,) -> Result < ProofComparison , ProofError >

review.body: { let Some (input) = input else { return Ok (ProofComparison :: UnavailableOpening) ; } ; let proof = decode_proof (input) ? ; let Some (anchor) = anchor else { return Ok (ProofComparison :: UnavailableAnchor) ; } ; let act = anchor . act ; if proof . id () != act . id () { return Err (ProofError :: AnchorIdentity) ; } if proof . epoch () != act . epoch () { return Err (ProofError :: AnchorEpoch) ; } if proof . position () != act . position () { return Err (ProofError :: AnchorPosition) ; } let commitments = act . header () . commitments () ; if proof . proposal () != & commitments . proposal . bytes { return Err (ProofError :: AnchorProposal) ; } if proof . dependency () != & commitments . dependency . bytes { return Err (ProofError :: AnchorCommitment) ; } let proposal = ProposalCommitment { recipe : profile :: PROPOSAL_RECIPE . to_owned () , bytes : * proof . proposal () , } ; let blinding = proof . host_dependency_blinding_value () . to_vec () . into () ; let dependencies = SecretBox :: new (Box :: new (DependencyIds (proof . dependencies () . to_vec ()))) ; let computed = profile :: dependency_commitment (proof . id () , & proposal , & blinding , & dependencies) . map_err (profile_cause) ? ; if computed . bytes != * proof . dependency () { return Err (ProofError :: OpeningMismatch) ; } Ok (ProofComparison :: Matches (Box :: new (proof))) }
review.item_premise: The selected proof comparison records public supplied values and closed refusals. It wraps S_D and D in the profile package’s carrier only at the commitment call, then checks all five act association fields; a matching comparison is equality, not authentication.
